name: Gradient Computation for 3D Gaussians
aliases: Chain rule gradient for scale and rotation
definition: Derivation of gradients for scaling (s) and rotation (quaternion q) of 3D Gaussians via chain rule through the covariance matrix Σ.
summary: Gradient Computation for 3D Gaussians computes loss gradients for rotation and scale by explicitly deriving partial derivatives of the intermediate matrix M, enabling efficient closed-form optimization without numerical differentiation.
